primitive_definition: PRIMITIVE-A-PARTIAL-SILOED-REPRESENTATION: A formation is present in distributed, existing evidence but is not perceptible through the practitioner's current representation of that evidence (whether that representation is a manual artifact/interview process, a narrow instrumented telemetry stream, a KPI/process-map aggregate, or a set of siloed-but-individually-complete datasets). KRYLO detects the formation by relating observations distributed across those existing sources. Not perceptible does not mean does not exist — this keeps the claim inside detect-not-predict, never discovery-from-zero-evidence.

classification_note: History of prior passes: v2.1 fixed canonical_domains to the six-domain lock. v2.2 classified 20 cases into 6 provisional families (FAM-DISTRIBUTED-STRUCTURE, FAM-TELEMETRY, FAM-FORMALIZATION, FAM-CROSSDOMAIN-SYNTHESIS, FAM-OPERATIONAL, FAM-SECURITY-CONTEXT) and added without_krylo/baseline. Applying a discriminating test (can the same experimental design falsify both members of a pair?) collapsed 5 of those 6 into one primitive (FAM-CROSSDOMAIN-SYNTHESIS and FAM-SECURITY-CONTEXT folded via identical mechanism to FAM-DISTRIBUTED-STRUCTURE/FAM-TELEMETRY). FAM-FORMALIZATION (cases 15, 27, 66) was tested against a stricter question — 'did any representation, formal or informal, of the claimed structure already exist before KRYLO?' — and failed to survive as a distinct primitive: #15 and #27 both have existing raw/recorded representations (non-price filings/records for #15, existing datasets/joins for #27) that just aren't yet combined, which is Primitive A's exact mechanism, not a distinct one. DISPOSITIONS: #66 (Statistics) — DROPPED. Any reframing that keeps an evidentiary floor collapses it into a duplicate of #27; without an evidentiary floor it asks KRYLO to detect structure with zero representation, formal or informal, which conflicts with CLAUDE.md's own grounding rule against presenting speculation as fact. #59 (Political/Public Affairs) — REMOVED FROM THIS MATRIX. Mechanism fits Primitive A, but its retention was a scope decision, not a technical one: this matrix validates KRYLO's commercial thesis (advantageous business/financial/operational/security/strategic positioning), and #59 pushes the claim toward general-purpose cross-domain OSINT instead, on the weakest verification design in the original 20. Founder decision: exclude from the primary matrix; not preserved as a stress-test array in this file — if a generalization/stress test is wanted later, it gets its own artifact, not a flagged-but-included row here.
